02 / HOW I BUILD

Pragmatism over ceremony.

Architecture should serve the product, not a diagram. I prioritize clear contracts, module boundaries and complexity justified by real requirements.

Domain-oriented modules

Responsibilities bounded by business capability. Cohesion where it matters, explicit integration across modules.

01

Clean Architecture, without dogma

I use layers and abstractions when they pay off. When they add overhead without value, I favor the more direct approach.

02

Intentional persistence

Entities may be persistence-aware when it simplifies a module. Isolation and decoupling are choices, not rituals.

03

Built to operate

Observability, retries, idempotency, security and deployment are design concerns — not afterthoughts.

04
